acceptance_evidence_matrix.criterion: Each approved source returns a minimally sufficient response or a precise access blocker.
acceptance_evidence_matrix.observable: All 62 inventory sources have a result; zero sources are production-approved pending human rights review; three representative candidate lanes were bounded-smoked and every other lane has a precise blocker.

acceptance_evidence_matrix.criterion: HTTP status, API version, rate-limit metadata, response schema hash, and retrieval time are recorded.
acceptance_evidence_matrix.observable: Every source result contains the fields; attempted probes record observations and blocked sources preserve explicit nulls with not-observed reasons.

acceptance_evidence_matrix.criterion: Smoke tests do not bulk-download data or expose secrets.
acceptance_evidence_matrix.observable: Three GETs were capped at 65,536 bytes with no retries; bodies, URLs, general headers, credential values, and restricted raw data were not retained.
